options.reason: The table provides 22 MFCC features plus Family, Genus, and Species, which describe the same call at coarser and finer taxonomic levels; per the joint-outcome rule all three are targets in a multilabel problem rather than treating the coarse levels as leakage. RecordID repeats across 7195 rows identifying the source recording, so it must be a grouping column to prevent segments of one recording spanning train/test splits.
options.title: multilabel
